## Mental Health and Social Connection Resources

The following organizations and resources provide information, support services, educational materials, and community-based opportunities related to mental health, emotional support, stress management, and social connection.

The Mental Health Coalition
[Resource Library](https://www.thementalhealthcoalition.org/resources/)

BrightLove Project
[Mental Health Organizations](https://www.brightloveproject.org/mental-health-organizations)

National Institutes of Health (NIH)
[Social Wellness Toolkit](https://www.nih.gov/health-information/your-healthiest-self-wellness-toolkits/social-wellness-toolkit)

American Psychological Association (APA)
[Ways to Manage Stress Through Social Support](https://www.apa.org/topics/stress/manage-social-support)

NAMI Georgia
[Support Groups](https://namiga.org/support-and-education/support-groups/)

Commit to Connect
[Staying Connected](https://committoconnect.org/connect-with-others/)

Georgia Mental Health Consumer Network
[Peer2Peer Warm Line (24/7)](https://www.gmhcn.org/peer2peer-warm-line)

Joiner
[Social Activities and Social Success](https://getjoiner.com/blog/best-social-activities-to-meet-new-people)
